d:
Some wildlife rescue calls are so unusual that even Turtleman has to expect the unexpected. Ernie Brown Jr. and Neal James head out to handle a series of bizarre animal encounters. From elusive critters in unlikely hiding spots to creatures that put up a surprising fight, these missions take wild animal rescue into strange new territory.
Whether it’s a tricky snake rescue, a stubborn raccoon or an animal nobody expected to find, each call brings a fresh challenge. With Turtleman leading the charge, can the team safely capture these strange creatures and get them out of trouble?
